WINDOWS 11 SECURITY RESPONSE SCRIPT
Created: 2026-11-05
Purpose: Monitor failed password attempts and trigger security responses

SCRIPT: C:\Users\Administrator\security_response_script.py

KEY FEATURES:
1. Monitors Windows Security Event Log for failed RDP logons (Event ID 4625)
2. Triggers when 2 consecutive failed passwords detected
3. Closes all RDP sessions (logoff *)
4. Executes secondary script (shell/backdoor)
5. Closes Explorer, Notepad, archiver windows
6. Deletes specified files

REQUIREMENTS:
- Python 3.12+ (already installed)
- pip install pywin32 psutil (may already be installed)
- Run as ADMINISTRATOR for event log access
- Edit CONFIGURATION section below

CONFIGURATION (edit these in the script):
  FAILED_ATTEMPTS_THRESHOLD = 2       # Number of failures to trigger
  SECONDARY_SCRIPT = r"C:\path\to\your\shell_script.py"  # CHANGE THIS
  FILES_TO_DELETE = [                  # Files to delete (CHANGE THESE)
      r"C:\path\to\file1.txt",
      r"C:\path\to\file2.txt",
  ]
  PROCESS_TERMINATION_LIST = [         # Processes to close/windows to close
      "explorer.exe",       # Windows Explorer
      "notepad.exe",      # Notepad
      "winrar.exe",       # WinRAR
      "7z.exe",           # 7-Zip
      "winzip.exe",       # WinZip
  ]
  CHECK_INTERVAL = 5                  # Seconds between event log checks

HOW IT WORKS:
1. Script reads Windows Security Event Log for Event ID 4625
2. Tracks failed RDP login attempts in memory
3. When threshold (2) reached → triggers security response
4. Actions executed:
   • Closes RDP sessions via logoff *
   • Executes secondary script
   • Terminates listed processes (explorer, notepad, archivers)
   • Closes windows matching those process titles
   • Deletes specified files with 3-pass overwrite

IMPORTANT NOTES:
- MUST run as Administrator for Event Log access
- Check interval is ~5 seconds (may miss very rapid events)
- Requires Windows Security Event Log to be enabled
- Test in isolated environment first
- All configuration at top of script: security_response_script.py

USAGE:
1. Edit CONFIGURATION section with your paths/settings
2. Run as Administrator: right-click security_response_script.py → "Run as administrator"
3. Script starts monitoring immediately
4. After 2 failed RDP password attempts → security actions trigger
5. Press Ctrl+C to stop monitoring

================================================================================
